name: Global rules (every discipline, both factions)
_source: Rules in profiles/_*.json are added to whatever discipline profile is active. 'missing' rules alert when the buff is not on you; by default only while in combat. Effect names are regexes (regex: true) so one rule covers all stim tiers. Class buffs are permanent once unlocked in Legacy, so they are deliberately NOT tracked here. The 'cast' rule (disabled by default) announces every ability a boss starts casting.
